strongest_angle: Break down the official Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport investigation into the Ulsan power plant boiler tower collapse, examining structural engineering failures during preparatory explosive demolition.

key_facts.fact: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport's Accident Investigation Committee announced on October 30, 2026, that the boiler tower collapse at the Ulsan Thermal Power Plant on November 6, 2025, was directly caused by excessively cutting support columns prior to demolition by blasting.
The deadly collapse at the Ulsan Thermal Power Plant resulted in the deaths of seven workers and injuries to two others due to poor structural reviews and overestimating column load-bearing capacity.

An investigation panel determined that structural reviews during the demolition preparation contained errors, such as overestimating steel plate thickness and underestimating the structure's overall weight.
